svg.aria-label: Distorted source: the DAC shape and the loop current it makes
svg.text: Distorted source: the DAC shape and the loop current it makes
62.5 Hz, 50 periods, fundamentals aligned. dpf: dac, commanded 0.9578, loop current 0.9583. The 3rd
keeps its size (29.8 %) but not its phase: the chain leads at 62.5 Hz and lags at 187.5 Hz, so the peak
moves. The reference measures what flows.
